data.name: Garden_Intro
data.value: Upload a picture of your plot (aerial photo or sketch) and mark the corners. The corners make a closed line. Enter the length of at least one edge in meters or the area of the plot, then the sizes are calculated; the more lengths you enter, the better the picture can be checked. Then draw areas: garden areas (several separate ones are possible), house, terrace, garage, parking space, and what belongs to you and what does not.

data.name: Garden_ImageHelp
data.value: JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB. When you replace the picture the corners stay where they are.

data.name: Garden_ErrType
data.value: Only JPG, PNG or WebP pictures are allowed.

data.name: Garden_ErrSize
data.value: The picture is larger than 5 MB.

data.name: Garden_ErrData
data.value: The input could not be saved.

data.name: Garden_ZoneName
data.value: Name of the area (e.g. garage, my half)

data.name: Garden_Hint
data.value: Click into the picture to set the next corner. Drag a corner to move it. A click selects it (dark); then “Delete selected corner” or the Delete key removes it; a double click or a right click removes it at once. Set the corners one after the other around the plot; the line closes by itself. Zoom with Ctrl + mouse wheel; scroll a zoomed picture with the mouse or your finger.

data.name: Garden_NoScale
data.value: Enter the length of at least one edge or the area of the plot, then the sizes are calculated.

data.name: Garden_WarnFew
data.value: At least 3 corners are needed for an area.

data.name: Garden_WarnCross
data.value: The boundary crosses itself; check the order of the corners.

data.name: Garden_WarnDeviation
data.value: Edge {0} is {1} % off the entered length in the picture; check the length and the corners.

data.name: Garden_AllowNote
data.value: Every area belongs to you or to one of the neighbours; you set their number and names above. Areas of the neighbours (for example the half of the garage that belongs to the neighbour) are taken off the plot and counted for that neighbour; the split by owner is shown below the picture. Of your own areas, house, terrace, garage, parking space and “Other built on” are built on and do not count to the garden area. As soon as you draw garden areas (several separate ones are possible), only their area is available; without a garden area the rest of your plot counts. “Other area” only marks and does not change the numbers. Only the part inside the boundary counts; overlapping areas are not counted twice, areas of the neighbours win over built-on areas and those over garden areas.

data.name: Garden_Placing
data.value: Click into the picture to place the shape (Esc cancels).

data.name: Garden_ShapeNote
data.value: You enter the size in meters, so at least one edge length must be known. You move a placed shape by dragging it. To change it, delete it and place it again.

data.name: Garden_SplitTitle

data.name: Garden_SplitNeedZone

data.name: Garden_SplitHint
data.value: The dashed line in the picture shows the split; parts 1 and 2 lie on the sides with the respective number. 50 % splits in the middle. Both parts get the kind you choose here.

data.name: Garden_SplitFromArea
data.value: Compute the line position from the area

data.name: Garden_CutDrawing
data.value: Click the start and the end of the line in the picture (Esc cancels).

data.name: Garden_CutFree

data.name: Garden_CutHint

data.name: Garden_ScaleAreaNote
